description: Selected-plate thumbnail relationship targets and their generated full-size and small PNG members.

mutants.description: A selected plate must use the selected-plate relationship branch instead of the default plate-one fallback.
The selected plate index is zero-based internally but archive plate names are one-based; rel-2 must target plate_2 for export_plate_idx 1.
The cover-thumbnail-small relationship must point to the selected plate's generated small member, not the next nonexistent plate.
